verdict.rationale: Martin documents first-party email (inbox) and calendar integrations that, once connected, let it read emails and calendar events and act on them. Nothing in the evidence covers connecting a cloud drive (files/documents). Community privacy worries are general skepticism, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: cloud drive/file storage connector, explicit search-and-answer grounding over connected sources, independent hands-on corroboration of email and calendar retrieval.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Have Martin read, draft, and reply to emails in your inbox.
Have Martin read, create, and update events in your calendar.
Once connected, you can tell Martin to read, draft, and reply to emails on your behalf.
Martin can call you at a specific time every morning to wake you up with the weather and your schedule.
